test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question a sentence has been given with a blank. You are required to choose the correct idiom to fill in the blank.

I'm ________until my family arrives from their holiday. I cannot wait to see them.

options.text: bearing the gift of the gab

solution:
The correct answer is: **'****counting down the days****'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"counting down the days"** means eagerly awaiting an event or occasion. (दिन गिनना)
 
• **​"Counting down the days"** refers to the act of eagerly anticipating something.
 
 
• **Example: **I'm **counting down the days** until my birthday party.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bearing the gift of the gab** (मधुर भाषण करने की कला): The ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you.

 
 
• **Example:** Politicians often **bear the gift of the gab** to persuade voters.
 
 
 
• **Losing ground** (मुकाबले में पिछड़ना): To become less successful compared to others.
 
 
• **Example: **The company has been **losing ground** to its competitors in recent years.
 
 
 
• **Getting myself into a mess** (मुसीबत में पड़ना): To get into a difficult or complicated situation.
 
 
• **Example:** By not studying for the exam, I really **got myself into a mess**.
 
 

199:Tb11,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
